artDirection.medium: Project-local vector diagrams with friendly dimensional cards and neural-network paths.
artDirection.palette: Deep midnight blue, cool cyan for inputs, vivid violet for learned features, warm coral for errors, and soft white labels.
artDirection.lighting: Gentle luminous nodes and restrained depth, with one active causal step highlighted at a time.
artDirection.texture: Clean matte fields with a subtle project-authored dot grid; no photographic media.
artDirection.compositionGrammar: A persistent bottom-to-top learning path evolves from pixels to features to prediction, then widens to show training feedback and limits.
artDirection.motionLanguage: Frame-driven node pulses, layer-by-layer reveals, error feedback loops, and calm causal handoffs.
artDirection.typography: Large concise Chinese concept labels for beginners; narration captions remain exclusively top-level.

continuityRules: Keep cyan mapped to input evidence, violet mapped to learned representations, and coral mapped to error or risk throughout.
Preserve the same upward layer direction whenever the network transforms simple features into complex ones.
End each Scene with one stable visual object that the following Scene can inherit without moving spoken frames.
forbiddenTreatments: No remote assets, directory scanning, CSS animation, CSS transition, formulas, or historical Scene imitation.
Do not render narration captions or duplicate full narration text inside Scene visuals.
Do not imply human-like understanding, consciousness, or guaranteed correctness.
Do not place semantic content outside the assignment-provided guarded content frame.
